tool-success-rate.name: Tool Success Rate
tool-success-rate.description: Fraction of tool calls that succeeded

tool-failure-count.name: Tool Failure Count
tool-failure-count.description: Number of tool calls that failed

retries.name: Retries
retries.description: Number of retry events detected in gateway logs

loops.name: Loops
loops.description: Consecutive identical tool calls (same name and arguments)

trajectory-efficiency.name: Trajectory Efficiency
trajectory-efficiency.description: Ratio of unique tool names to total tool calls (higher = more diverse usage)

working-set-rebuild-factor.name: Working-Set Rebuild Factor
working-set-rebuild-factor.description: Cumulative input tokens divided by peak invocation input tokens

context-growth.name: Context Growth
context-growth.description: Ratio of total tokens to first-request tokens

artifact-production.name: Artifact Production
artifact-production.description: Count of outputs/artifacts produced by the agent

progress-stagnation.name: Progress Stagnation
progress-stagnation.description: Repeated unchanged tool failures without observed progress

ineffective-retries.name: Ineffective Retries
ineffective-retries.description: Repeated failures of an unchanged scoped tool operation

premature-termination.name: Premature Termination
premature-termination.description: Session termination with explicitly recorded unmet objectives

completion-misrepresentation.name: Completion Misrepresentation
completion-misrepresentation.description: Explicit success claims contradicted by scoped execution evidence

policy-near-miss.name: Policy Near-Miss Rate
policy-near-miss.description: Fraction of successful traces that left guard or policy objectives unsatisfied

skill-constraint-coverage.name: Skill Constraint Coverage
skill-constraint-coverage.description: Fraction of configured skill constraints that were exercised and passed

exploration-error.name: Exploration Error
exploration-error.description: Unmet objectives attributable to insufficient search

exploitation-error.name: Exploitation Error
exploitation-error.description: Unmet objectives attributable to gathered evidence that was never used

state-revisit-probability-rep.name: State Revisit Probability REP
state-revisit-probability-rep.description: Fraction of canonical state visits that revisit an already visited state

recurrence-determinism.name: Recurrence Determinism (RQA DET)
recurrence-determinism.description: RQA DET: fraction of recurrent points forming diagonal (repeated-subsequence) lines

recurrence-laminarity.name: Recurrence Laminarity (RQA LAM)
recurrence-laminarity.description: RQA LAM: fraction of recurrent points forming vertical (stagnation) lines

recurrence-trapping-time.name: Recurrence Trapping Time (RQA TT)
recurrence-trapping-time.description: RQA TT: average length of vertical recurrence lines

recurrence-rate.name: Recurrence Rate (RQA RR)
recurrence-rate.description: RQA RR: density of recurrent state pairs across the run

event-entropy-rate.name: Event Entropy Rate
event-entropy-rate.description: Normalized conditional Shannon entropy rate of the ordered event sequence

lempel-ziv-trajectory-complexity.name: Lempel-Ziv Trajectory Complexity
lempel-ziv-trajectory-complexity.description: Normalized LZ76 complexity of the canonical event sequence

tool-output-consumption-rate.name: Tool Output Consumption Rate
tool-output-consumption-rate.description: Fraction of tool outputs referenced by a later action

end-to-end-lineage-completeness.name: End-to-End Lineage Completeness
end-to-end-lineage-completeness.description: Fraction of final outputs traceable to tool or observation evidence roots

action-provenance-coverage.name: Action Provenance Coverage
action-provenance-coverage.description: Fraction of consequential actions with a provenance path to tool or observation evidence

premature-termination-gap.name: Premature Termination Gap
premature-termination-gap.description: Declared completion conditions still unsatisfied at termination

evidence-saturation-stopping-lag.name: Evidence Saturation Stopping Lag
evidence-saturation-stopping-lag.description: Events elapsed between all objectives being satisfied and the run stopping

dependency-order-violation-rate.name: Dependency Order Violation Rate
dependency-order-violation-rate.description: Fraction of dependent objectives satisfied before their prerequisites

objective-coverage.name: Objective Coverage
objective-coverage.description: Fraction of declared objectives that were completed

grounding-accuracy.name: Grounding Accuracy
grounding-accuracy.description: Fraction of actions that were valid in the state in which they were issued

tool-wise-score.name: Tool-Wise Score
tool-wise-score.description: Longest correct execution prefix against a reference trajectory, with parameter credit

trajectory-ndtw.name: Trajectory nDTW
trajectory-ndtw.description: Normalized dynamic time warping similarity to a reference state trajectory

code-search-recall.name: Code Search Recall
code-search-recall.description: Fraction of reference patch files located during the run

code-read-precision.name: Code Read Precision
code-read-precision.description: Fraction of distinct read or inspected files touched by the reference patch

code-edit-precision.name: Code Edit Precision
code-edit-precision.description: Fraction of distinct edited files touched by the reference patch

process-alignment-fitness.name: Process Alignment Fitness
process-alignment-fitness.description: Fraction of observed tool-sequence checks allowed by a configured process model
